why: Removes `panel`, which is not a layer and is easy to read as redundant beside a record that names every pane. It is four screens rather than one: the main menu, the pause screen and both outcome screens are states of the same container, and dropping it takes the keyboard and the D-pad off all four at once -- including the pause screen, which is the one surface a player reaches mid-match with a controller already in their hands.
